lines: {target}? Shorelines change under your feet. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Beach, tell them: Watch the <wavy>tide</wavy>, the turtles, and the drowned at dusk. I will be at the stonecutter.
Sand looks peaceful until it shifts. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Beach is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Beach as the place where land starts losing to water. I will keep spare blocks close.
{target}? Calm water can still go bottomless. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Deep Lukewarm Ocean, tell them: Do not mistake warm waves for safe waves. I will be at the stonecutter.
